none: PAS FindID 1017853: Roman coin: nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, possibly irregular issue on a small chipped flan. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right; pelloidal legend. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 13.6mm, Weight: 1.33gms, die axis: 12
